144.news_title: Xtreme 3.0: Features for ultimate arcade gameplay!
144.long_description:
The Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 consists of some of the most advanced features that can be found within the arcade industry. Built by industry professionals, our Xtreme 3.0 demonstrates versatility through its ability to reside perfectly in both home gaming setups and commercial arcade environments. The following features are really what makes the Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 unique and special:
  • Monitor: 32 Inch (16:9) monitor which supports 15khz, 31khz and up to 1080P HD inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. At 1080P, the monitor also features a 1.3ms response time.
  • Sound: whilst we could have just put in a cheap and easily accessible sound system, the Xtreme 3.0 is equipped with a 2.1 audio sound system custom designed for arcade, including subwoofer.
  • Controls: The Xtreme 3.0 arcade machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world’s premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble-free operation.
  • Cabinet: The machine is constructed with 2mm powder coated steel with acrylic panels. Internally, the machine is layered allowing you to update your machine whenever you would like. Additionally, the Xtreme 3.0 includes 6 input power board.
  • Wiring: Designed with Jamma wiring system, the machine also supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard (optional).
  • Control Panel: the machine comes equipped with a standard 2 player arcade, 6 buttons per side. However, as we strive for longevity, the panel is upgradeable allowing you to turn it into an 8 button per player control panel, even allowing you to make the arcade itself 4-player coop.
    • Whilst these phenomenal features are a part of our base Xtreme 3.0, the following add-ons can be purchased:
  • Game Wizard Add-On: Includes our Highway I/O board allowing for plug and play compatible with almost all current consoles.
  • JVS Arcade Add-On: includes the JVS I/O board to allow for modern USB controller games compatibility.
  • Arcooda Rear Multimedia Add-On: with HDMI, USV and RJ45 input, turn your cabinet into a media centre or connect your cabinet to your gaming hub and stream your gameplay to other monitors.
  • Custom Artwork: add your own designs to game header, acrylic plastic and control panel overlay.
